data.one_liner: Facilitates working with physical quantities, units, uncertainty, and arbitrary precision.
data.what_it_does: Provides 75+ typed quantities, unit conversions, string parsing for measurements, and dimensional formula validation. It also supports relative standard uncertainty propagation and arbitrary precision calculations.
use_when: Building science, engineering, or calculation-heavy applications that need strict unit discipline
Parsing natural language strings into strongly typed physical quantities like speed or mass
Validating symbolic formulas dimensionally before evaluation
avoid_when: Your application does not perform physical calculations or deal with physical units
strengths: Automatic type inference during arithmetic operations
Robust string parsing for units and compound measurements
NIST CODATA constant integration and arbitrary precision support
weaknesses: Adds significant domain-specific API overhead if you only need basic numeric math
